geographic_scope: Primarily central Myanmar; overlaps parts of administrative regions
climate_context: Hot, seasonally dry; rainfall and irrigation access vary locally
main_crops: Pulses, oilseeds, sesame, groundnut, pulses and cereals; exact local mix requires crop-statistics validation
key_constraints: Water scarcity, drought, heat, soil erosion and variable rainfall
evidence_note: Regional synthesis only; do not infer township-level suitability

geographic_scope: Deltaic parts of Ayeyarwady and adjoining coastal lowlands
climate_context: Monsoonal delta; flood and drainage conditions vary
main_crops: Rice/paddy dominant; other crops vary by land, season and salinity
key_constraints: Flooding, drainage, salinity in coastal/deltaic settings, storm impacts
evidence_note: Regional synthesis only; soil chemistry requires mapped or sampled evidence

geographic_scope: Coastal areas of Rakhine, Tanintharyi and other coastal stretches
climate_context: Humid monsoon; coastal exposure and local rainfall vary
main_crops: Rice and locally important perennial/plantation crops; validate by district statistics
key_constraints: Flooding, coastal salinity, erosion, storm exposure
evidence_note: Do not merge with delta soils; local evidence needed

geographic_scope: Shan uplands; administrative boundaries do not define AEZ
climate_context: Elevated terrain; temperature, rainfall and soils vary with altitude and aspect
main_crops: Maize, pulses, vegetables, tea and other upland crops in documented local systems; validate locally
key_constraints: Slope erosion, soil depth limits, rainfall variability
evidence_note: Crop presence is broad regional context, not a suitability rating

climate_context: Cooler high elevations; strong local gradients
main_crops: Upland cereals, maize, pulses and horticulture in some areas; evidence coverage uneven
key_constraints: Steep-slope erosion, access constraints, shallow soils
evidence_note: Insufficient evidence for detailed region-wide crop calendar

geographic_scope: Rakhine and Chin hill/coastal transition areas
climate_context: Humid to seasonally variable; strong terrain effects
main_crops: Rice and upland crops; specific crop mix requires local statistics
key_constraints: Erosion, landslides, flooding and access constraints
evidence_note: Avoid treating the whole zone as homogeneous

geographic_scope: Lower river plains outside the delta core
climate_context: Monsoonal; irrigation and floodplain conditions vary
main_crops: Rice and other seasonal crops; validate against official statistics
key_constraints: Flooding, waterlogging, drainage and riverbank erosion

geographic_scope: Irrigated pockets within central dry areas; not a separate administrative unit
climate_context: Water availability depends on infrastructure and allocation
main_crops: Dry-season rice and other irrigated crops where supported; crop-by-crop verification needed
key_constraints: Irrigation reliability, salinity risk in some settings, water competition
evidence_note: Do not generalize irrigated crop calendars across all dry-zone locations
